description: Profiles one public page: title, summary, organisations and other entities, topics, sentiment and public contact points. Returns { url, finalUrl, title, summary, entities: [{ text, type }], topics, sentiment: { label, score }, contact_points: { emails, phones, pages, social } }. Only role mailboxes (info@, sales@ ...) are returned. Price: 12 credits (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

url.description: Public http(s) URL. Private, loopback, link-local and metadata addresses, internal hostnames and this service's own hosts are refused.
